verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies bulk operations. Tailscale documents automating the tailnet with infrastructure-as-code providers and webhooks, offers an official CLI, and uses a central policy file that governs access across all devices, so many items can be managed together. No source explicitly describes a bulk action such as mass device approval, removal, tagging or user changes. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-operation documentation (multi-select or batch API endpoints), concrete examples of mass device or user actions, and independent hands-on corroboration.
